_doc: Source of truth for every repo's public-facing presence. brand/tools/generate.py draws the images from it, brand/tools/sync_repos.py renders each repo's README, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY from it, foundation/brandcheck.py lints the result. Positioning text comes from doctrine/positioning.json, never retyped here. Edit this file, not the generated output.

license.name: Ultrastable License v1.0 (USL-1.0)
license.summary: Source-available. Free for non-commercial use: read it, run it, study it, change it, share it. Any commercial use needs a Commercial License with revenue share.

proof: Ultrastable runs on itself. Its roadmap, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget and specs are run by the same code it gives everyone else. Verify it: `python3 -m foundation selfhost --verify` in ultrastable/ultrastable.

repos.name: ultrastable
